explanation: Core mechanism, ER/cyclin D1 rationale, in vitro combination effects, and Rb-dependence are all well supported. However, the claim that palbociclib is 'reversible' and 'orally administered' is not established by any evidence shown here.
suggested_rewrite: Palbociclib is a small-molecule inhibitor of CDK4 and CDK6 [cite drug label/PK data for oral/reversible properties]. Cyclin D1-CDK4/6 complexes phosphorylate Rb, releasing E2F/DP transcription factors that drive G1-to-S entry; blocking this step produces cell-cycle arrest in susceptible tumor cells, as shown in vitro.
